title: Three-channel Mersenne tail bound and sharp single-skip fatal-gap criterion

concepts.label: three-channel Mersenne tail lower bound
concepts.note: An explicit rational expression retaining the first three dyadic channels of the Mersenne tail.

concepts.label: represented skip fraction
concepts.note: A positive fraction u/(2L) together with the arithmetic decomposition 2^k*u+a=2L+u.

concepts.label: dyadic skip-safety margin
concepts.note: The stronger elementary sufficient condition u<=a.

concepts.label: fatal-gap numerator region
concepts.note: The complementary strict region 3a<2u forced when the represented fraction lies above a tail lower bound.

concepts.label: unit-numerator skip
concepts.note: The u=1 specialization, which is automatically safe under the represented decomposition.

concepts.label: actual Mersenne tail
concepts.note: The infinite reciprocal-Mersenne tail that strictly dominates the three-channel expression.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The quantity mersenneTailLB3 k is the explicit three-channel rational lower-bound expression used to compare represented greedy-skip fractions with the Mersenne tail.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project representation, not a novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition alone proves no inequality against the actual Mersenne tail and says nothing about the greedy orbit.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every k at least one, 3/(3*2^k-1) is strictly smaller than mersenneTailLB3 k.
statement_nodes.engine: positive rational comparison of the explicit three-channel expression
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean proves the inequality; no priority or novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The comparison contains no greedy-orbit or achievement-set conclusion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For positive k,u,a,L satisfying 2^k*u+a=2L+u, the arithmetic margin 2u<=3a implies u/(2L)<mersenneTailLB3 k.
statement_nodes.engine: two-thirds numerator-margin comparison against the explicit tail bound
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No comparison with external prior art has been completed.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is a sufficient single-rank criterion, not a necessary condition and not an orbit-wide producer.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the positive represented decomposition with numerator one, 1/(2L) is strictly below mersenneTailLB3 k.
statement_nodes.engine: unit-numerator specialization of the two-thirds margin
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the explicit u=1 specialization of the preceding arithmetic criterion.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The conclusion concerns only the auxiliary three-channel bound.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If mersenneTailLB3 k<=T<u/(2L) under the positive represented decomposition, then 3a<2u.
statement_nodes.engine: contrapositive separation from the two-thirds safe region
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean proves the necessary inequality; no external novelty judgement is supplied.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The strict two-thirds region is necessary under the displayed fatality hypotheses, not sufficient and not known to occur.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The same fatality hypotheses force the numerator u to be at least two.
statement_nodes.engine: exclusion of the unit numerator by the safe-region theorem
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an immediate arithmetic consequence of the fatal-region inequality.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: It does not exclude any fatal numerator u>=2.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the fatal numerator is odd, the same fatality hypotheses force u to be at least three.
statement_nodes.engine: parity refinement of the numerator lower bound
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an elementary parity specialization.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Oddness is load-bearing; the theorem makes no assertion without it.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The dyadic margin u<=a implies the sharper two-thirds margin 2u<=3a, and the latter implication is strict for an explicit existential pair.
statement_nodes.engine: exact comparison of two sufficient arithmetic regions
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an elementary comparison internal to the formal development; the manuscript's external-prior comparison remains unverified.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Strict containment of sufficient arithmetic criteria is not equivalence with actual greedy survival.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every k, mersenneTailLB3 k is strictly smaller than the actual Mersenne tail mersenneTail k.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No external priority claim is made for the exact bound.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Dominating the auxiliary bound does not control the actual greedy residual.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For the positive represented decomposition, 2u<=3a implies u/(2L)<mersenneTail k.
statement_nodes.engine: transport of the three-channel safe region through the strict tail lower bound
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean proves the transported criterion; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is sufficient at one represented skip and gives no universal orbit avoidance.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the positive unit-numerator decomposition, 1/(2L) is strictly below the actual Mersenne tail.
statement_nodes.engine: unit-numerator specialization transported to the actual tail
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the u=1 specialization of the actual-tail safety theorem.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: It does not prove that all actual skips have unit numerator.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The threshold theorem is the fundamental rational comparison proved from the explicit three-channel expression.
The represented decomposition and 2u<=3a reduce the skip fraction to the threshold dominated by the three-channel bound.
The unit-numerator theorem is the u=1 instance of the two-thirds safety criterion.
Under mersenneTailLB3 k<=T, fatality forces the strict complement 3a<2u of the safe two-thirds region.
The strict fatal-region inequality and positivity exclude the unit numerator.
Oddness sharpens the general lower bound u>=2 to u>=3.
The comparison node classifies the sharp hypothesis used by the safety theorem against the stronger dyadic sufficient condition.
The theorem validates the represented expression as a strict lower bound for the actual infinite tail.
The three-channel inequality transports to the actual tail through mersenneTailLB3 k<mersenneTail k.
The unit-numerator three-channel bound transports through the strict lower bound for the actual tail.
The actual-tail unit theorem is the u=1 specialization of the actual-tail two-thirds criterion.
